content.text: Still scrolling Harel's page. I'm on the קרנות מחקות section now and have three screens left.

I looked through the whole Harel page. I'm not putting money anywhere today.

**What I took away (fairly sure):** if I do anything with Harel, it'll be one of the "עוקב מדד S&P 500" tracks. They look almost the same in every section:

- Fee: about 0.5% "מהחיסכון".
- Return: "13.7%" for 3 years and "11.9%" for 5 years.
- Money in it: billions, so lots of people are already in it.

The one that clicked most was the S&P 500 track in קרן השתלמות: 0.5% and 13.71%. I'm already in a קרן השתלמות through work anyway. I'm not sure I'm reading 13.7% right, though. The header says "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול", so I think it's per year and before the fee. No idea what that comes to in shekels on my 30,000.

**How I went through it**
- **Top:** The heading "הראל", then "כל המוצרים של הראל" and a row of buttons with "105" products. That's a lot. I didn't tap any filter and just scrolled.
- **קופת גמל להשקעה:** Fees of 0.54–0.58%. Most rows had no number for return, just "פחות מ־3 שנים". The S&P row showed 13.7% and 2.3 billion ₪.
- **קרן השתלמות:** Same picture. The S&P 500 track was 0.5% and 13.71%, with 7.9 billion ₪ in it.
- **תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים:** Scrolled fast. "גמל מסלול מניות" showed 21.37%, which looked big, but it's 98% shares and I don't know if I can even join that one.
- **חיסכון לכל ילד:** The fee is 0.01%, which looks super cheap, but it's for kids. Skipped it.
- **קרן חדשה מקיפה / כללית:** Pension stuff. The fee was 0.16% plus 1.47% "מההפקדות". Didn't get the two numbers, scrolled on.
- **קרנות מחקות / קרנות סל:** Short lists with "הראל מחקה S&P 500" and three fee lines each. The coloured tags made me wary.
- **"מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל":** Folded lists. Didn't open any of them.

**Words I didn't get:** "נאמן", "צוברת", "מנוטרלת מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע", "ההפקדות" versus "החיסכון", "עוד לא דווח", "4A" / "4D", the "PF-06" / "PF-10" tags, and "קבועים" / "משתנים".

**Where I got stuck or bored:**
- Around the pension sections (screen 6–7) I was bored. The same track names repeat in every section, so I couldn't tell which section is meant for someone like me.
- The fees are only in percent. Nothing tells me what I'd actually pay in shekels.
- The return columns are half "פחות מ־3 שנים", so there's nothing to compare.
- The little round charts make no sense to me. One row says 99% shares and 99% foreign currency, another says 0% shares and 96% foreign currency.
- On a phone I'd have closed it by the third screen.
